featured_reviews.name: Shailendra Kumar
featured_reviews.review_text:
It was a productive and memorable trip, specifically tailored for birding enthusiasts.

Highlights
---------------------------------------
Planning & Logistics (9/10):
The session planning across multiple locations was excellent. It allowed for a diverse range of sightings and maximized our time in the field.

Guides & Expertise (8/10):
The guides were fantastic. Their deep knowledge of bird species, habitats, and behavior was evident and greatly enhanced the photography experience.

Food (8/10):
For a Bird watching or wildlife-centric trip, the food exceeded expectations. Every meal was fresh, tasty, and well-prepared.

The Property (8/10):
The stay location was beautiful and very convenient. Having birding opportunities right on the property was a significant plus.

Areas for Improvement:
---------------------------------------
Staff Service & Engagement (7/10): While the trip was great, the service at the property needs attention. I found the local staff to be somewhat non-interactive and "un-entertaining" with guests.

Response Times:
There was a noticeable gap in handling basic requests. Simple orders like tea or coffee often took a very long time to arrive or were missed entirely. Even with a low number of guests on-site, the service felt slow.

My overall experience (8/10):
The hosting and technical planning of the birding sessions were top-notch. If the property can bridge the gap in staff proactiveness and service speed, this would be a perfect 10/10 experience.

featured_reviews.name: Nama Sivayam
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am very fond of birding in Sattal, Uttarakhand, and have visited the region several times earlier on my own for birding and bird photography. This time, I joined a 4-day birding trip organised by NK Jungle Trail, led by Mr. N. K. Rajput, and it turned out to be a truly memorable experience.

Mr. N. K. Rajput organised the trip exceptionally well. Our stay was at Bhimtal Lodge, run by Mr. Prabhu, a well-known and highly respected birding guide in the Sattal region. Both Mr. Prabhu and Mr. NK Rajput took us to various birding hotspots around Sattal and ensured that almost all the birds on our checklist were sighted. Their local knowledge, patience, and ability to spot and identify birds were truly commendable.

I am 62 years old, and apart from me, there were seven other birders in the group. One of them, Mr. Ravi, is 70 years old, while the remaining six were youngsters in the age group of 30–35 years. Despite the age differences, the group bonded beautifully. The younger members mingled very well with us seniors, and sharing birding knowledge, photography tips, and life experiences made the trip even more special.

Beyond birding, we thoroughly enjoyed the travel time, evening chit-chats, and relaxed discussions after long days in the field. The entire team was extremely supportive, caring, and respectful, always ensuring that everyone was comfortable and well taken care of.

Overall, this trip was not just about bird sightings—it was about companionship, learning, mutual respect, and creating lasting memories. I sincerely thank NK Jungle Trail, Mr. N. K. Rajput, and Mr. Prabhu for organizing such a wonderful and enriching birding experience. I would highly recommend NK Jungle Trail to anyone interested in birding in Sattal.

featured_reviews.name: Saptarshi Ray
featured_reviews.review_text:
I recently had an incredible trip organized by The Jungle Trail, and I cannot recommend them enough for anyone planning a wildlife getaway. They managed every detail of the logistics and planning perfectly.
​The Highlights:
​Accommodation: They recommended Wildcat Resort, which is a fantastic property. The stay was comfortable, the service was great, and it served as the perfect base for our safaris.
​Seamless Logistics: Our transfers to and from Nagpur were flawless. The car was on time, and the driver was professional, making the long drives very comfortable.
​Expert Gate Selection: Since this was my first time visiting, I relied on their expertise. They suggested the Sirkheda Buffer, and it was a brilliant call—we were lucky enough to get a fantastic tiger sighting!
​Personal Touch: What impressed me most was their proactive service. They were always reachable and checked in daily for feedback to ensure we were having a good time.
​It was an awesome, hassle-free experience from start to finish. I’m already looking forward to my next adventure with them!

- Jim Corbett and the rare Great Hornbill sightings

- Visits to Tadoba, Pench, Kanha, and Bandhavgarh — we had 20 safaris in total on our tour, spotting tigers, wild dogs, sloth bears, countless birds, and the endless beauty of India’s wilderness
- Our final days brought us to Khajuraho’s mesmerizing temples and the tastiest aloo chaat street food we’ve ever had! A spontaneous stop Gwalior to see the awe-inspiring Gopachal Jain Statues and Gwalior Fort was the perfect way to close this magical journey before returning to Delhi.

If you are planning to visit India — especially for your first time — we cannot recommend Wanderlust Travel Hub highly enough. Raj creates journeys that are not just well-organized and safe, but deeply personal. Every lodge, guide, and experience feels handpicked with love and authenticity.

We will carry India — and Raj — in our hearts forever.

featured_reviews.name: Honey Sharma
featured_reviews.review_text: The Mind Voyage delivered an unforgettable Morocco romp for our group of friends, masterminded by Mohana. We dove into Marrakech souks' frenzy, Fes medinas' twists, and Sahara dune treks by camel at golden hour. Essaouira's riad greeted us with a starry rooftop dinner—mint tea flowing, Mohana's note invoking a proverb on friendship's strength. Private hammams and Berber cooking classes sparked laughter as we botched tagines together. Smart pacing: high-octane morning markets for haggling hauls, chill afternoons in riads' tiled havens with plush comforts. Mohana sourced crowd-free street food delights, ensuring safe, bold flavors. Views from terraced riads left us speechless. No tourist checklists—just immersive vibes that bonded us tighter. We flew home laden with spices, inside jokes, and tales for years. This was friendship fueled by Morocco's soul.

featured_reviews.name: Ankit Shaw
featured_reviews.review_text: As a solo traveler, The Mind Voyage's Morocco itinerary with Mohana felt like a personal whisper from the desert. She unveiled Marrakech's souks, Fes's ancient alleys, and Sahara's endless sands without the tourist gloss. My Essaouira riad arrival featured a solo candlelit setup with mint tea and Mohana's proverb note on self-discovery. Intimate Berber cooking lessons, sunset camel treks, and hammam rituals grounded me deeply. Mornings pulsed with souk haggling; afternoons drifted in shaded riad gardens, surrounded by zellige artistry and sumptuous bedding. Mohana anticipated my street food passion, guiding me to authentic, safe gems off the beaten path. No crowds or schedules—just raw immersion that stirred my spirit. I left with spices, journals full of insights, and a renewed sense of wanderlust. Mohana didn't just plan a trip; she crafted a transformative solo journey.

featured_reviews.name: vijaya dhoundiyal
featured_reviews.review_text:
This was my first group trip and first with TMV. It was my friend who coaxed me to sign up for this trip & I can’t thank her enough for making me experience this wonderful trip to Italy. This is one of the most memorable trips I have taken so far. The itinerary was extensive and very well planned, stretching to a period of fourteen days in different cities of beautiful Italy. And I must say my jaw dropped every time we entered a new city, seeing the amazing architecture, beautiful countryside and stunning/diverse landscapes. It was a relaxed trip with no rushing to the next place, though most of us felt adding few more days would have made the trip perfect. Nevertheless It was a very well planned itinerary with diverse experiences ranging from the wine tasting in the lush green countryside Tuscany, beach hopping in picturesque Cinque terre, exploring rich history in majestic Rome and amazing Pompeii ruins, gondola ride in the fascinating maze of canals in Venice and hiking in spectacular Dolomites (which remains my most favourite). Especially the road journey from Bolzano to Dolomites will remain etched in my memory forever for the beautiful landscapes with miles of vast green meadows, tall pine trees, terraced vineyards and beautiful country houses with bright pink/red flowers hanging from the balconies.
A big shoutout to Mohana who dons the hat of the sailor and the chef with equal expertise. She was not only available 24*7 for us but also a vey amiable companion. She very lovingly prepared a very sumptuous Indian meal for all of us in Como which was one of the most beautiful gestures I have experienced in a long time. May you soar higher girl💖.
This trip will always hold a very special spot in my heart for all the right reasons and looking forward to many more with my girl gang and TMV.

featured_reviews.name: Karan Thakur
featured_reviews.review_text: The Mind Voyage transformed our family vacation into Morocco's beating heart, thanks to Mohana's genius planning. With kids in tow, we navigated Marrakech souks' chaos, Fes medinas' mysteries, and Sahara dunes by camel at dusk. Our Essaouira riad welcomed us with a family-style feast under stars—mint tea, fresh pastries, and Mohana's note sharing a proverb about family unity. Hands-on Berber cooking classes had the little ones kneading dough; hammams relaxed us post-trek. Perfect pacing: energetic mornings bargaining for lanterns, lazy afternoons in riad courtyards with intricate tiles and cozy linens. Mohana curated kid-safe street eats from hidden stalls, dodging tourist hordes. Riads brimmed with character—rooftop views stealing breaths. We returned home with stories, spices, and unbreakable memories, no checklists needed. Pure, crowd-free immersion for all ages.

featured_reviews.name: Satyam
featured_reviews.review_text:
My debut group adventure—and my first with TMV—kicked off when a close friend nudged me to join the Italy escapade. I'm forever grateful to her for unlocking such an unforgettable journey across Italy's gems. Spanning two full weeks, the itinerary masterfully wove through vibrant cities, leaving me awestruck at every turn by the jaw-dropping architecture, rolling countryside, and ever-changing vistas.

We savored a leisurely pace, free from frantic dashes, though many of us agreed a couple extra days would've elevated it to perfection. Highlights included sipping wines amid Tuscany's emerald hills, beach-hopping along Cinque Terre's cliffs, delving into Rome's ancient grandeur and Pompeii's haunting ruins, gliding on a Venice gondola through its labyrinthine waterways, and trekking the breathtaking Dolomites—my absolute standout. That scenic drive from Bolzano, with endless meadows, soaring pines, terraced vines, and flower-draped village homes, is seared into my mind.

Shoutout to Mohana, our multitasking marvel who captained the boat and whipped up feasts with flair. Always on hand and endlessly warm, she delighted us with a hearty Indian spread in Como—a gesture that touched our hearts deeply. She's since led an epic Morocco group trip, and I can't wait to join more under her guidance. May your adventures keep soaring, Mohana!

Italy carved a permanent place in my heart, and I'm already plotting reunions with my girl squad and TMV.

I would highly recommend this

featured_reviews.review_text:
I was excited about joining The Evening Mile of South Bombay at the ExtraMile India Curated Walktours because one is hardly a tourist in one's own city. And it turned out to be such a good decision because the experience was extremely insightful and fun. The walk tour was very well-planned and on time. Tanmay shared in detail deep facets of every place visited;  his narration entailed stories of the Erstwhile Bombay, the current relevance and status. He deftly switched into English, Hindi, Marathi to cater to his audience and used wit and humour which made the walk and talk refreshing. Leena, as his resourceful partner, ensured that the arrangements were in place and made us very comfortable, providing snippets of the places from her end too.
All in all, a great experience and worth recommending!

featured_reviews.name: Anurag Bhalerao
featured_reviews.review_text: Tanmay knows his history and his geography. He took us through the 1800s and 1900s seamlessly during our evening mile tour in South Bombay. We strolled with a completely different perspective as Tanmay unmasked the many nuances of the architecture and history of the spots we visited and even the ones we didn't. I wish Tanmay all the best and hope to join him on his future tours!

featured_reviews.review_text:

Started at Flora Fountain,down Veer Nariman road, to Horniman Circle. Visited the St Thomas Cathedral after a very long time...Around the small area of the historic Fort precint . Tanmay has the gift of the gab, n recounted history in a very interesting n humorous manner

featured_reviews.review_text:

Definitely worth doing this, with friends and family.

⭐ 1 Star – Worst Builder Experience of My Life (Avant Heritage)
Buying a home in Avant Heritage has been the biggest mistake of my life.
I purchased an under-construction flat in 2023. As per RERA, possession was promised in September 2025, while the builder committed May 2025. Today it’s February 2025, and every single day they say “soft possession in a few days” — the same lie on repeat with zero accountability.
But delays are just the start.
At the time of sale, the sales team guaranteed lifetime open views, only for Avant to start constructing another building right in front of our flat — completely blocking the view. This is nothing but mis-selling and deception.
The sales and CRM teams are full of false promises. From day one, my buying journey has been pathetic, mentally exhausting, and filled with half-truths and broken commitments.
The so-called “premium” standards are laughable:
Lobby height is shockingly low — older buildings look more premium than this.
Flat was sold as Vastu compliant, but professional Vastu analysis showed only 20% compliance.
Construction quality and planning are far below expectations for a brand like Avant.
This builder clearly prioritizes sales over honesty and delivery. Once they get your money, you’re left chasing timelines, clarity, and basic transparency.
⚠️ Strong warning:
If you value peace of mind, transparency, and getting what you’re promised — stay away from Avant Heritage. This is not a premium builder experience, it’s a premium nightmare.

name: ZW Biodiversity Walks with Meehir Pawar
description: Embark on a guided journey through Mumbai's diverse ecosystems with Zoological Wisdom's Nature Walks, where every step reveals the city's hidden natural wonders. Led by an experienced field naturalist, Meehir Pawar, our tours explore the vibrant biodiversity of forests, wetlands, and coastal habitats. Discover the intricate lives of insects, birds, and plants through engaging, hands-on learning experiences designed for everyone from curious beginners to seasoned enthusiasts. We offer a unique blend of natural history, ecology, and observation, inviting you to connect with the wild side of Mumbai. Private and customized walks are also available.

featured_reviews.name: Sameera Gawkar
featured_reviews.review_text: We had a wonderful experience on the BNHS Nature Walk and much of the credit goes to Mihir. His deep knowledge of plants, trees, insects and other often-overlooked species made the walk both engaging and insightful. We were fortunate to spot a variety of butterflies, flowers, scorpions and even pugmarks along the trail. It was a truly enriching experience and I would highly recommend Mihir's biodiversity walks to anyone looking to explore and appreciate nature more deeply.
